description: Runs told as scenarios (an idea's outcome, what its gate read against an input that reads 100, and when the reading landed) and the chart each must draw: the host helper's digest points (tests/server/test_run_dashboard.py) and the run page's performance fold (run-dashboard-conformance.test.ts) both read this file, so the two folds and the statement that checks them cannot drift apart.

scenarios.name: step-line
scenarios.description: Ideas that pass, pass without beating the best, fail after a great reading, still run, and fail before any reading.

scenarios.name: landed-out-of-order
scenarios.description: The idea that began first lands last: the chart plots results in the order they landed.

scenarios.name: landed-at-the-same-instant
scenarios.description: Ideas whose results land at one instant, the run clock's first (0), are plotted in the order they began, whatever each one's reading or outcome.

scenarios.name: minimize
scenarios.description: A lower reading is better and an improvement reads as the input over the result.

scenarios.name: slower-than-the-input
scenarios.description: An idea that passed but reads below the input stands as not better: the input stays the best.

scenarios.name: nothing-measured
scenarios.description: No gate read anything: there is no input to compare with and no ratio to draw.
